profile_text.body:
Curriculum Associates describes itself as delivering evidence-based curriculum and assessment intended to help learning communities and students. It says it works with one million educators and connects assessment to instruction and data to discovery. Its i-Ready portfolio combines assessment with core and supplemental instruction, which the company says turns data into insight, saves teachers time, and improves student outcomes. The site also describes Ellevation, an all-in-one English language development platform serving nearly half the nation's English Learners, and Stile, a middle school science curriculum customized for every state. The company states it partners with 6sense for marketing and advertising, using hashed email addresses from submitted forms to identify organizations and deliver advertising.

The company's tracked product is i-Ready, listed under education and research AI, described as an adaptive diagnostic and lessons used for adaptive diagnostic and instruction with students in kindergarten through eighth grade and teachers. A note on the entry says it was found in research for The AI Ready School and was not independently verified, and that student age and privacy details are not verified. Pricing recorded from a California state filing lists i-Ready Assessment at $8 per student or a site license of $1,130 to $4,670 by enrollment, with instruction priced separately; the note cautions that this covers assessment pricing only.
